source_caveats: The source is not a canonical or minisuperspace derivation and does not prove the Phase 15A Bianchi-I-to-FLRW tangency claim.

The official TeX definitions of nabla_m xi and its conjugate immediately after the gravitino transformations print an n index in the Kähler-connection terms while the left-hand side carries m. No silent repair is allowed; any m-for-n emendation must be explicitly frozen in the convention map and tested as a source caveat.

The unnumbered conjugate-chiralino transformation in the frozen line span prints an undotted xi with a dotted free index in its Kähler-Christoffel term and prints chibar with an unbarred species label in its Kähler-weight term. PHASE15A_CONVENTION_MAP.json must packetize both glyph mismatches explicitly. The one-field flat Kähler specialization makes the Christoffel term identically zero, but it does not license silently inventing any nonzero coefficient; the conjugate species label must be fixed only by the frozen conjugation map.
The matter scalar, chiralino, and F component transformations are unnumbered in the official TeX; their exact identity is frozen by the official line span and main-TeX hash.

The action is invariant only on shell after the auxiliary fields are integrated out, as stated immediately after the auxiliary definitions. Stage A therefore may not substitute their equations of motion.

exact_section_and_equation_scopes.use: Equation (2.4) is the general Hamiltonian constraint decomposition; (2.6)-(2.13) shift/rescale variables and expose chiralino second-class constraints; (2.15)-(2.21) impose time gauge and give fermionic Dirac brackets; (2.22) is the general conjugate supersymmetry-constraint anchor. exact_section_and_equation_scopes.section: Reduced supersymmetry constraints and quantum treatment
exact_section_and_equation_scopes.use: Reduced fermion rescalings, Dirac brackets, and S/Sbar formulas are recorded only as a sign/convention warning. They retain the k=+1 S^3 normalization and cannot be converted to k=0 by deleting the curvature-looking term.

source_caveats: The general canonical formulas do not supply Hohl's off-shell auxiliary-field transformation system.

The text says preservation of the explicit gravitino ansatz can be justified by earlier references; this paper does not furnish the complete source-derived Bianchi-I discarded-mode census required by Phase 15A.
The paper uses sigma both in its S^3 volume normalization and reduced expressions. Setting sigma or sigma^2 to zero would erase normalization as well as curvature information and is forbidden.
The explicit paper proceeds through a k=+1 Friedmann model and quantum constraints; no physical inner product or target T^3 tangency theorem is imported into Stage A.

sources.title: Super-Minisuperspace and New Variables
sources.role: Pure self-dual Bianchi type-A reduction and classical supersymmetry-subalgebra closure control only. It is not a matter, old-minimal-component, or FLRW transformation parent.
formalism_scope: Jacobson's complex chiral/self-dual canonical N=1 supergravity in Ashtekar variables
classical Poisson algebra of the homogeneous supersymmetry constraints
formal quantization of type-A models without a supplied physical inner product

exact_section_and_equation_scopes.use: Canonical self-dual variables and constraints; equations (8)-(10) display the supersymmetry brackets and (11) gives the connection reality condition. Equation (10) is the mixed-bracket anchor within this pure self-dual formalism.
Homogeneity kinematics and the Bianchi structure-constant decomposition. The text following (14) defines type A by V_a=0 and identifies Bianchi I by M^{ab}=0.

Reduced brackets and constraints. Equation (21) contains extra mixed-bracket terms proportional to contractions C_ba^b; the following text states that they vanish for type A and that the supersymmetry constraints fail to close for type B. Equations (22)-(23) give the further-reduced type-A supersymmetry constraints.

source_caveats: Pure is a field-content description: the variables are gravitational self-dual variables and the gravitino; the introduction leaves matter inclusion for future work.
M^{ab} in this paper is the Bianchi structure-constant matrix, not Hohl's old-minimal complex auxiliary scalar M.
Bianchi I is a type-A homogeneous model here, but the paper does not impose isotropic FLRW, add a chiral multiplet, or derive the Phase 15A discarded-mode transformations.
The closure statement is the classical homogeneous supersymmetry-subalgebra result in the stated self-dual formalism, not a full old-minimal matter constraint-algebra theorem.

sources.role: Matter-free Wess-Zumino-gauge FLRW ansatz-preservation and transformation-rule scope control only. It is not the Phase 15A parent and supplies no chiral-matter transformation system.
formalism_scope: classical matter-free 4D N=1 supergravity in Wess-Zumino gauge
quadratic Killing equations for g_mn and the gravitino bilinear
FLRW ansatz and transformation rules, including an arbitrary-time-gauge extension
no derived reduced action, Hamiltonian, canonical constraint algebra, physical Hilbert space, or physical charge

exact_section_and_equation_scopes.use: The metric and gravitino-bilinear isometry conditions used to motivate the paper's relaxed FLRW notion.

Equation (29) is the one-spinor vector-spinor ansatz. Equation (57), preservation of the vanishing spin-3/2 component, is explicitly imposed as an extra condition. Equations (62a)-(62c) give the conformal-FLRW multiplet transformations.

The spatially projected extension retains N and psi_0 independently and gives modified transformations. Equations (92)-(93) receive only a one-dimensional Lorentz-constraint interpretation; they are not a derived four-dimensional canonical algebra.

The authors place matter, spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, scalar potential, and a more automatic gauge-independent reduction in future work, and state that the reduced-multiplet condition is enforced by hand.

source_caveats: Equation (57) is an imposed preservation condition, not an output of an off-shell matter-coupled Bianchi-I tangency census.

The paper's conformal-time construction says consistency induces N=a; equations (62a)-(62b) themselves preserve N/a and do not uniquely select the value of that constant ratio without the additional source choice.

The arbitrary-time-gauge construction is obtained by spatial projection and deviations proportional to gauge fields; it does not derive the target compact-T^3 off-shell action or a canonical generator.
The paper explicitly has no chiral matter. Its nonzero background spin-1/2 gravitino is not a matter chiralino or the bosonic-FLRW goldstino background used in Phase 14A.
forbidden_inferences: use this source as the Phase 15A matter parent
treat its imposed spin-3/2 condition as a proof of the preregistered Bianchi-I-to-FLRW tangency criterion
import its one-dimensional Lorentz interpretation as a canonical Dirac bridge, Q_phys, or branch map

phase15a_scope_guards: The source packet freezes literature inputs only; it is not evidence that the target tangency claim SUPPORTS or CONTRADICTS.
The target transformation parameter is homogeneous epsilon(t), with epsilon and dot epsilon treated according to the later frozen J^1 ledger. Nothing here establishes arbitrary periodic epsilon(x).

The compact T^3 topology, globally periodic compensator class, FLRW defining functions, transverse projector, coefficient ring, and cokernel map are preregistered local construction requirements, not results quoted from these papers.
The one-neutral-chiral, K_phys=Z Zbar, W identically zero, no-vector specialization is a Phase 15A model choice and requires an explicit convention map before use.
No k=0 expression may be obtained by deleting a curvature-looking term or setting a fiducial-volume symbol to zero in a k=+1 formula.
Off-shell transformation tangency is necessary but not sufficient for Dirac-Bergmann stabilization, graded canonical closure, differentiability, a nonzero Q_phys, quantization, or branch exchange.
Phase 14A remains INCONCLUSIVE_UNCONSTRUCTED and Phase 14B remains closed regardless of this packet.
